blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel has urged Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Paolo Panelo, to come up with more realistic stories if his goal is to divert public attention from the impeachment trial, following his claim that a no-election scenario is being floated for 2028. In a press briefing on Thursday, prosecution spokesperson and Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said he understood why Duterte’s camp was resorting to diversionary tactics: because, in his view, the defense’s case was so weak.
